claims.claim: Advanced Connectivity growth is offsetting deliberate legacy runoff: Q2 revenue rose 2.3% to $31.6B while management attributed growth primarily to fiber and wireless and lower Legacy revenue to copper-network decommissioning.

risks: Legacy contraction can obscure underlying Advanced Connectivity growth
fiber acquisition integration and network investment remain capital intensive
contradictions: Consolidated growth is positive while a large legacy revenue pool is intentionally shrinking; execution must be judged on replacement economics rather than headline growth alone.
unknowns: incremental ROIC of acquired Lumen fiber assets
long-run churn and household economics of converged customers

recommendation.reason: Correctly structured primary-source Scout perspective replaces prior malformed lineage and makes the operating transition reusable.
